summary: Strive, Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose its bitcoin holdings and capital structure as of May 1, 2026, including a bitcoin treasury of 15,000 BTC, cash equivalents of $97.9M, and holdings in Strategy preferred stock of $50.4M. The filing also announces share counts for its common and preferred stock. This is a routine update regarding treasury assets and capitalization, not an event triggering a special-situation category. References to a merger with Semler Scientific appear only in forward-looking cautionary language and are not the subject of this filing. No actionable deal terms exist.
